title: 2022 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election
summary: The Social Democrats chose a new leader on 28 May 2022, four months after losing the January election to an absolute Socialist majority. Rui Rio did not stand; the two candidates were Luís Montenegro and Jorge Moreira da Silva, and Montenegro won in the first round, of about 45,000 members registered. It is in the atlas because the man it chose is the one who put the Social Democrats and the CDS back together as the Democratic Alliance, came first at the early election of March 2024 and formed a government in April.
